replacements.new: - [x] Implement scalable sampling for large budgets. — ✅ PR #1003 / #1002 SAMPLE-F1: exact mixed-radix rank/unrank addresses every candidate in the 329-decimal-digit `M(G0-fin-v1,(64,32))` population without enumeration; global Floyd SRSWOR and positive-stratified SRSWOR have proved inclusion probabilities and Horvitz–Thompson weights, an independent exhaustive oracle gives all 10 size-2 subsets equally often, and a 4,096-candidate replay is unique and covers all 2,048 `(n,r)` strata. This is a finite registered-grammar probability design; the separate 10^6 and 10^8 execution rows remain open.
